en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a cobbled street and small square in an old village. In the foreground several women are washing clothes at a stone fountain or trough. Stone houses with wooden shutters surround the square, and a large tree stands near the fountain. In the background are ruins or castle walls on a hill with cypress trees. Printed text at the bottom gives a caption and publisher information.
